text.en:
The territorial jurisdiction of the Port of Duman gas is hereby
expanded and particularly described as fol.lOws:
"Beginning at point marked 1 on the plan, thence to point 2 at
a distance of 500.00m with bearing N40o30' W, thence to point 3 at
a distance of 1,600.00m with bearing S49°30' W, thence to point 4 at
a distance of 1,500.00m with bearing S40o30' E, thence to point 5 at
a distance of 1,600.00m with bearing N49°30' E, thence to point 1,
the point of beginning at a distance of 1,000.00m with bearing
N40o30' W, all in all comprising a total area of 2.400.000.00 sq. m.
more or less."

The Dumangas Port Zone, as expanded, is hereby placed under the
administrative jurisdiction of the Philippine Ports Authority, which shall,
consistent with the regional industrial plans of the Government, implement a
program for the proper zoning, planning development and utilization of the port.

All other orders, proclamations and issuances or portions thereof
which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, thisJG1'
of our Lord, nineteen hundred and ninety nine.
By the President:
RONALDO B. ZAMORA
Executive Secretary
